en: Black-and-white postcard showing the bow and port side of the motor ship m/s Birkaland moored at a quay. The ship's name "BIRKALAND" is clearly visible on the hull, with masts, rigging, and flags above. At the bottom of the image, printed text provides technical data about the vessel and the shipping line, including its deadweight, speed, and that it belongs to Svenska Orient Linien of Gothenburg.
